The '''magnetic flashback suppressor'''<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> was a parabolic shaped dish that was affixed to the end of weapons such as the [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|KX9 laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]<ref name="SWS" /> and the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] from [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> For the KX9 laser cannon, the suppressors reflected excess [[Laser/Legends|laser]] energy produced by the [[Laser tip/Legends|laser tip]] away from the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser barrel]] and fuselage of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" /> The suppressors also safeguarded the cannon from the occasional unstable laser bolt.<ref name="ICS" /> The laser cannons were part of the armaments of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]],<ref name="SWS" /> and the curved shape of the suppressors were very recognizable.<ref name="NEGTWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
